svg.aria-label: Connected components of the Gaussian primes under steps of length 2
svg.text: every Gaussian prime in the window, joined to every other within distance 2; each island (connected component) in its own colour
Two primes are joined when they
are at most 2 apart. Every Gaussian
prime off the four ±1 ± i has odd
a + b, so its steps are (±1, ±1),
The dashed ring encloses the island
the same cluster as in moat.svg
of each other get different colours.
The sea between them is the moat.
